name: Keep Design System
title: keepdesign.io
shortDescription: Keep Design System offers a refined suite of tools for creating web designs and dashboards efficiently. It is tailored for designers and developers seeking to streamline their workflow and enhance productivity. An example use case is a developer using Keep's React components to quickly prototype and iterate on a new project.
cons: Limited to single user on personal license
Pricing might be prohibitive for some
Focused primarily on React, less so on other frameworks

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Ant Design
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Rich in design features and React components
